At 1280x800 scrollWidth == 1280 with cards laid out 4 per row and sharp. Judge Reset [data-testid=judge-reset-btn] hard-navigates back to '/' and the entrance gate reappears (verified after extended wait — url==/, enter-with-sound-btn count==1, hero copy 'The Guardian is ready.' visible). Direct /hub fast path renders the new hub with brand header and 0 arrival-cinematic instances. (7) SCREENSHOTS captured: /tmp/arrival_shot1_landing.png (THE GUARDIAN ARRIVES), /tmp/arrival_shot2_portals.png (seven cards), /tmp/arrival_shot3_toronto.png (Toronto skyline + shot4 dawn), /tmp/arrival_shot4_shield.png (STAARWAARDD sigil shield), /tmp/hub_mobile.png, /tmp/hub_desktop.png, /tmp/portal_work_screen.png, /tmp/after_judge_reset.png. No red screen, no audio errors, no route errors.

issues: Cosmetic only: during SHOT 4 the sigil-shield overlay uses backgroundColor rgba(253,251,245,0.88) that partially reveals the Guardian silhouette + Toronto skyline underneath (visible in /tmp/arrival_shot4_shield.png). This actually reads as a nice bleed-through but if E1 wants a cleaner finale beat consider bumping alpha to 0.96 or adding a stronger LinearGradient tint. Not a bug.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' fires once during Hub mount. Comes from a component setting pointerEvents as a top-level prop (likely one of the *ring/*shield/*flash overlays in hub-arrival-cinematic.tsx or the greetingBubble in cinematic-hub.tsx). Move the value into style: { pointerEvents: 'none' } to silence. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: migrate any remaining `pointerEvents="none"` JSX props to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning. Grep '/app/frontend/components/staarwardd' for `pointerEvents=` on JSX elements.
OPTIONAL cosmetic: raise shieldWrap backgroundColor alpha from 0.88 to ~0.96 in hub-arrival-cinematic.tsx if a fully opaque finale is desired.
NO blocking work — all seven user acceptance checklist items pass. Ready to demo per instructions (DO NOT PUBLISH per request).
critical_code_review_comments: hub-arrival-cinematic.tsx cleanly stages all 5 shots with useNativeDriver on every Animated.timing/spring, and correctly clears the setTimeout handles + pauses raw Audio elements on unmount — no leaks.
playFx() defensively returns null on non-web and try/catches new window.Audio() — safe for Expo Go native runtime where window is undefined.

PORTAL_ART array maps `id: 'events'` to `name: 'Community'` — matches the checklist requirement that the events gateway is labeled COMMUNITY across both the cinematic and the Hub grid. Consistent with lib/staarwardd/portal-data.
CinematicHub uses [arrival, setArrival] initialised from `greet` prop, so direct /hub (greet=false) skips the cinematic entirely — verified at runtime. Good separation.

One minor DRY note: hub-arrival-cinematic re-imports GuardianCharacter and re-implements caption styles that also exist in cinematic-hub. Could be extracted to a shared style module later — not blocking.
